summary: This is a foreign private issuer Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of its own Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between May 26-29, 2026. YPF repurchased notes at an average price of 99.84% of nominal value, totaling Ps. 71.9 billion (US$51 million par). The notes were originally issued in July 2024 and April 2025 under its Frequent Issuer framework, maturing July 2026. This is a routine debt management transaction, not a special situation. The repurchased notes will be held in portfolio. No change of control, tender offer, or strategic event is involved.
